# Design {#sec-design}

```{r}
#| include: false
source("../_setup.R")
sc <- synth_counts(n_per_group = 4)
n_per_group <- table(sc$samples$group)
```

::: {.callout-tip}
## In plain terms
This chapter says which samples were compared, how many there were, and which thresholds the analysis used.
:::

::: {.callout-note}
## Status
Last run on the synthetic example data, `r format(Sys.Date(), "%Y-%m-%d")`. Replace with your data source and date.
:::

**Question.** What comparison does this book make, and with how many samples per group?

**Design.** Two groups, control and treated, with `r n_per_group[["control"]]` and `r n_per_group[["treated"]]` samples. Features are tested one at a time. Nothing in this chapter is tested. It only describes the design.

The analysis compares `r fmt(nrow(sc$samples))` samples across `r fmt(nrow(sc$counts))` features, at an FDR threshold of `r report_param("fdr")`, a minimum absolute log2 fold change of `r report_param("lfc_threshold")`, and a minimum mean count of `r report_param("min_count")`.
